description.zh: 流程ID，即为在创建WhatsApp Flow时通过[CreateFlow](~~2638742~~)接口返回的FlowId。
description.en: The flow ID. This is the FlowId returned when you call [CreateFlow](~~2638742~~) to create a WhatsApp flow.

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已有成功创建的WhatsApp Flow。

- 若您没有已成功创建的WhatsApp Flow，可调用[CreateFlow](~~2638742~~)接口创建WhatsApp Flow。

#### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为5次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have created a WhatsApp flow.

- If you have not created a WhatsApp flow, call the [CreateFlow](~~2638742~~) API to create one.

#### QPS limit

This operation allows a maximum of 5 requests per second per account. Excess requests are throttled and may result in service interruptions.
